program.section_heading: Level 3 - Interior Design Professional, Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: The outcome of this Interior Design certificate of achievement is to prepare students for entry-level employment as a professional interior designer and for industry certifications.

blocks.name: Interior Design Foundation - Level 1, Certificate of Achievement (Required Prerequisites)
Level 2 Interior Design Associate in Science Degree (67 units including Level 1 Certificate)

records.words: List B minimum depends on the Core option: 1 course if Core Option 1, 2 courses if Core Option 2; recorded minimum 1 and stated 3-6 (printed '6-3'). List B also allows 'Any List A Course not already used'. ENGL C1002/C1002H count in List B only if not used for Core.

outcomes: This program serves all English majors whether their emphasis at the CSU level will ultimately be the study of literature, rhetoric and non-fiction writing, or creative writing.
Students will be eligible and prepared for admission (SB 1440 and Education Code 66746) to California State University system schools.
careers: teaching at the K-12 or community college level
literary scholarship at the graduate level
non-fiction essay writing in literary, business, and scientific journals

records.words: Math Required Courses block prints 5-10 units while listing MATH A180/A180H AND MATH A185/A185H; the 5-unit low end is ambiguous (perhaps Calculus 1 alone can suffice for some students). Recorded as both required; reviewer should check.

outcomes: Describe the constituents of the Universe and the relevant physical processes underlying their behavior.
Become familiar with the methods of observational astronomy and the analysis of data.
Develop the necessary knowledge and skills to analyze evidence and evaluate claims as related to astronomy.
Students who complete the degree will be prepared for admission to California State University/University of California schools in astronomy/astrophysics.

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score; checks.arithmetic, coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found. The capture keeps no page text, so a note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.

select json_build_object(
  'listed', (select count(*) from v),
  'on_run', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run),
  'record_is_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.record = v.before_record),
  'checks_is_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.checks = v.before_checks),
  'both_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.record = v.before_record and r.checks = v.before_checks),
  'already_after', count(*) filter (where r.checks = v.after_checks),
  'checked_now', count(*) filter (where r.checked),
  'confirm_matches', count(*) filter (where lv.verdict = 'confirm'
                                       and lv.requirements_fp = public.program_record_fp(r.record)))
  from v join public.program_requirement_records r
    on r.college = v.college and r.control_number = v.control_number
  left join lateral (select pv.verdict, pv.requirements_fp from public.program_record_verdicts pv
                      where pv.college = v.college and pv.control_number = v.control_number
                      order by pv.id desc limit 1) lv on true;
